harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) with routed addresses on both its non-management segments: eth1=192.168.1.1/24 facing node2, eth2=192.168.2.1/24 facing node3, with IPv4 forwarding enabled globally and per-interface. Made this persistent via ifupdown2 drop-ins (/etc/network/interfaces.d/eth1, eth2) and /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf, both applied automatically at boot with no manual reapplication step. node2 got a static IP 192.168.1.2/24 on enp8s0 plus a route to 192.168.2.0/24 via 192.168.1.1; node3 got 192.168.2.2/24 plus a route to 192.168.1.0/24 via 192.168.2.1 — both via nmcli, which is natively persistent on RHEL10. Verified node2<->node3 reachability through node1 before any restart, then restarted all three nodes one at a time (node1, then node2, then node3) using each OS's native reboot, confirmed each node's boot_id in /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id changed, and re-verified interface addresses, forwarding sysctls, routes, and end-to-end ping between node2 and node3 after each restart — including after node1 itself came back, proving the routed configuration returns on its own.
actions_performed: Inspected topology on node1/node2/node3 (ip -br addr/link, ip route)
Identified node1 eth1<->node2 enp8s0 and eth2<->node3 enp8s0 segment mapping via IPv6 link-local neighbor discovery
Assigned 192.168.1.1/24 to node1 eth1 and 192.168.2.1/24 to node1 eth2, enabled net.ipv4.ip_forward and per-interface forwarding
Configured node2 enp8s0 = 192.168.1.2/24 with static route to 192.168.2.0/24 via 192.168.1.1 (nmcli)
Configured node3 enp8s0 = 192.168.2.2/24 with static route to 192.168.1.0/24 via 192.168.2.1 (nmcli)
Verified node2<->node3 ping success through node1
Persisted node1 config via /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth1, /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth2, and /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes
Restarted node1 via /sbin/reboot, polled until exec available, confirmed boot_id changed, verified eth1/eth2 addresses, forwarding sysctls, and node2<->node3 ping all recovered automatically
Restarted node2 via /sbin/reboot, confirmed boot_id changed, verified enp8s0 IP/route persisted via nmcli and ping to node3 succeeded
Restarted node3 via /sbin/reboot, confirmed boot_id changed, verified enp8s0 IP/route persisted via nmcli and ping to node2 succeeded

evidence.requirement: node1 baseline topology and segment mapping (eth1->node2, eth2->node3)
evidence.summary: ip -br addr/link on all nodes plus IPv6 link-local neighbor discovery confirmed node1 eth1 faces node2 enp8s0 and eth2 faces node3 enp8s0

evidence.requirement: node1 given routed addresses on both segments + forwarding enabled
evidence.summary: Assigned 192.168.1.1/24 to eth1, 192.168.2.1/24 to eth2, enabled global and per-interface IPv4 forwarding

evidence.requirement: node2 static IP + route to node3 segment configured
node3 static IP + route to node2 segment configured
working routed path between node2 and node3 via node1 (pre-restart)
evidence.summary: ping from node2 (192.168.1.2) to node3 (192.168.2.2) succeeded 3/3

evidence.requirement: node1 configuration made persistent across reboot
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth1, eth2 (ifupdown2 auto stanzas) and /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf (forwarding sysctls)

evidence.requirement: pre-restart boot identity baseline captured for all nodes
evidence.summary: Captured /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id on node1 (39fdb9ab...), node2 (73237116...), node3 (434803ac...) before any restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: ack, changed boot identity, and automatic recovery of routed config + connectivity
evidence.summary: Reboot acked before disconnect; boot_id changed to 329bbe46...; eth1/eth2 IPs and forwarding sysctls restored automatically; node2->node3 ping succeeded again post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: ack, changed boot identity, and automatic recovery of static IP/route + connectivity
evidence.summary: Reboot acked; boot_id changed to e71f4600...; enp8s0 IP/route (nmcli-persisted) intact; ping to node3 succeeded 3/3

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: ack, changed boot identity, and automatic recovery of static IP/route + connectivity
evidence.summary: Reboot acked; boot_id changed to 7e1d9e8f...; enp8s0 IP/route (nmcli-persisted) intact; ping to node2 succeeded 3/3, confirming full end-to-end recovery after all three restarts
